canonical_term: Neb. Rev. Stat. § 77-1314 County Assessor Use of Income Approach
summary: Nebraska statute requiring the income approach, including discounted cash-flow analysis, for certain commonly owned vacant or unimproved subdivision lots held for sale/resale, with TERC process if another method is asserted.
plain_language: For a specific kind of subdivision-lot situation, Nebraska law points the assessor to income/DCF analysis unless a statutory process supports another technique.
